Beer glasses with golden beer and froth, skewers, plates, chopsticks and hotpot ingredients cover the table. Distinct charming characters, readable silhouettes, richly detailed environmental pixel art and playful social interactions. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks anywhere, including clothing, screens, cards, restaurant decor and objects. Fully opaque background; the restaurant interior and warm background colors must cover the entire rectangular canvas edge to edge. No transparency, no cutouts, no empty corners, no black corner regions, no black border, no vignette.
